purge_bug_fix_section.kind: 预存缺陷（T24 引入 MEETING 到统一入口时未跑过 purge 分支；本次 T25 首次端到端 /recycle-bin/purge type=MEETING 才暴露）
purge_bug_fix_section.symptom: POST /api/data-migration/recycle-bin/purge {type:MEETING, ids:[...]} 返回 {code:50000,message:'Internal server error'}；后端日志：Caused by: java.sql.SQLException: You can't specify target table 'dm_issue_relation' for update in FROM clause (SQLState HY000, error code 1093)
purge_bug_fix_section.root_cause: MeetingService.purge 内的 DELETE 语句 `DELETE FROM dm_issue_relation WHERE tenant_id=? AND (related_type='MEETING' AND related_id=? OR issue_id IN (SELECT r.issue_id FROM dm_issue_relation r JOIN dm_issue i ON i.issue_id=r.issue_id AND i.deleted=1 WHERE r.related_type='MEETING' AND r.related_id=?))` 的目标表 dm_issue_relation 在子查询 FROM 中自引用，被 MySQL 直接拒绝
purge_bug_fix_section.fix: 拆两步：先 `SELECT DISTINCT r.issue_id FROM dm_issue_relation r JOIN dm_issue i ON i.issue_id=r.issue_id AND i.deleted=1 WHERE r.related_type='MEETING' AND r.related_id=?` 得 issueIds；空分支执行 `DELETE FROM dm_issue_relation WHERE tenant_id=? AND related_type='MEETING' AND related_id=?`；非空分支执行 `DELETE FROM dm_issue_relation WHERE tenant_id=? AND (related_type='MEETING' AND related_id=? OR issue_id IN (?, ?, ...))`。语义严格保留（同时级联清理软删问题的其它关联行）；无事务/权限/审计变更
purge_bug_fix_section.scope_attribution: 本任务附带修复；Owner 若判定应独立成需求，可仅拆账本结构而不动代码
purge_bug_fix_section.verification: 修复后 mvn install -DskipTests + backend-dev.sh restart；探针 #7 从 500 → 200；回收站 6 行→ 4 行 seed 基线
